decisions.allow: trusted enough to sync and use as a normal skill
decisions.reduce: quarantine-compatible local draft; retain findings and do not treat as trusted
decisions.deny: contains secrets, critical unsafe instructions, or insufficient usable content

hard_invariants: Source material and generated skill instructions are untrusted data until screened.
No skill may install or execute upstream code during extraction or quality review.
No skill promotes itself or silently rewrites shared skills.
OpenRouter is disabled unless FIELDNOTE_ENABLE_OPENROUTER=1 is explicitly set after owner re-approval.
Every trusted skill has source provenance, actionable instructions, a content fingerprint, and freshness status.
Secrets and critical executable or credential patterns are denied, not merely down-scored.
Duplicate and auto-extracted draft skills remain quarantined until enhancement or merge.
quarantine_salvage: retain source links and transcript identity
extract safe schemas, checklists, test ideas, and architecture patterns
remove permissionless autonomy, anti-detection, live financial action, and silent mutation instructions
rewrite useful concepts from first principles with attribution
promote only after re-audit and exact diff review
